visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Middle Class Forgets super
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The path through three classes should print A>B>C, but the program prints B>C.

solution.explanation: C's super.path() calls B's method, but B no longer calls A's, so the chain is cut and A never contributes. Each override has to call super.path() for the whole chain to be included.
